Our Story

From Assam's tea country to your cup.

The pack describes Seuj as bringing the authentic flavour of Assam, where rich soil, pristine nature and generations of tea growers come together to create something special.

The brand message emphasizes carefully sourced tea from Assam and a cup with strong aroma, refreshing taste and a connection to the region's tea-growing tradition.

“Pure Assam. Pure Nature.”
How to Brew

A simple four-step cup.

1

Measure

Use about 1 tsp of tea (around 2.5 g) per 150 ml cup.

2

Boil

Add water and milk as preferred; the pack suggests about 95–100°C.

3

Steep

Let it brew for approximately 3–5 minutes.

4

Strain & Enjoy

Strain into your cup and enjoy your Assam tea.
